{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\core\BattleManager.gd","new_string":"	get_tree().paused = false
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
	_cam_snap = true
	# 运镜结束再播开局播报：欢迎→准备→全军出击
	SfxManager.announce_chain(["welcome", "ready", "attack"])
	_spawn_lane_guides()


# ---------------- 开局地面推荐分路指引 ----------------
# 蓝（我方）/ 红（敌方）各画三条路的地面光带 + 方向箭头，玩家英雄对应分路加粗高亮；
# 12 秒后淡出释放，避免干扰对线期视野。
const LANE_GUIDE_HOLD := 12.0
const LANE_GUIDE_FADE := 1.6

func _spawn_lane_guides() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(hero):
		return
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "LaneGuide"
	add_child(root)
	var blue := Color(0.30, 0.68, 1.0)
	var red := Color(1.0, 0.34, 0.28)
	# 己方（蓝）基地在 (-53,53)，敌方（红）基地在 (53,-53)
	var my_lane := _lane_for_role(str(hero.role))     # 玩家推荐分路
	# 我方三条路
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-35, 0, 55), Vector3(-15, 0, 56), Vector3(28, 0, 58)],
		blue, my_lane == "farm")
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-40, 0, 40), Vector3(-27, 0, 27), Vector3(-14, 0, 14)],
		blue, my_lane == "mid")
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-55, 0, 35), Vector3(-56, 0, 15), Vector3(-58, 0, -28)],
		blue, my_lane == "clash")
	# 敌方三条路（镜像）
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(53, 0, -53), Vector3(35, 0, -55), Vector3(15, 0, -56), Vector3(-28, 0, -58)],
		red, false)
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(53, 0, -53), Vector3(40, 0, -40), Vector3(27, 0, -27), Vector3(14, 0, -14)],
		red, false)
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(53, 0, -53), Vector3(55, 0, -35), Vector3(56, 0, -15), Vector3(58, 0, 28)],
		red, false)
	# 双方泉水标记环：蓝圈 = 我方，红圈 = 敌方
	for pair in [[Vector3(-53, 0, 53), blue], [Vector3(53, 0, -53), red]]:
		var ring := MeshFactory.create_torus_ring(3.6, 4.4, pair[1], true, 0.55, true)
		ring.position = Vector3(pair[0].x, 0.18, pair[0].z)
		ring.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
		root.add_child(ring)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(LANE_GUIDE_HOLD)
	tw.tween_method(func(v: float):
		if not is_instance_valid(root):
			return
		for c in root.get_children():
			if c is GeometryInstance3D:
				(c as GeometryInstance3D).transparency = v
	, 0.0, 1.0, LANE_GUIDE_FADE)
	tw.tween_callback(root.queue_free)

func _lane_for_role(role: String) -> String:
	match role:
		"射手":
			return "farm"
		"法师":
			return "mid"
		"刺客", "辅助":
			return "mid"     # 打野/游走以中路河道为主轴
		_:
			return "clash"   # 战士 / 坦克 → 对抗路

func _add_lane_guide(parent: Node3D, pts: Array, color: Color, highlight: bool) -> void:
	var width: float = 4.2 if highlight else 2.6
	var alpha: float = 0.60 if highlight else 0.34
	var y: float = 0.19
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	for i in range(pts.size() - 1):
		var a: Vector3 = pts[i]
		var b: Vector3 = pts[i + 1]
		var d := Vector3(b.x - a.x, 0.0, b.z - a.z)
		if d.length() < 0.05:
			continue
		d = d.normalized()
		var n := Vector3(-d.z, 0.0, d.x) * width * 0.5
		var a0 := Vector3(a.x, y, a.z) + n
		var a1 := Vector3(a.x, y, a.z) - n
		var b0 := Vector3(b.x, y, b.z) + n
		var b1 := Vector3(b.x, y, b.z) - n
		st.add_vertex(a0); st.add_vertex(b0); st.add_vertex(b1)
		st.add_vertex(a0); st.add_vertex(b1); st.add_vertex(a1)
		# 方向箭头：每段中点一个指向前方的三角
		var mid := Vector3((a.x + b.x) * 0.5, y, (a.z + b.z) * 0.5)
		var tip := mid + d * width * 1.15
		var l := mid - d * width * 0.35 + n * 1.15
		var r := mid - d * width * 0.35 - n * 1.15
		st.add_vertex(l); st.add_vertex(tip); st.add_vertex(r)
	st.index()
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.mesh = st.commit()
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	mat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	mat.albedo_color = Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, alpha)
	mat.emission_enabled = true
	mat.emission = color
	mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 1.6 if highlight else 0.9
	mat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	mi.material_override = mat
	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	parent.add_child(mi)

const PICK_COUNTDOWN: float = 5.0

func _play_pick_countdown() -> void:
	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()

	layer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child(layer)
	var root := Control.new()
	root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	layer.add_child(root)
	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.06, 0.58)
	dim.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	root.add_child(dim)
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	vb.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	tip.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.93, 0.95, 1.0))
	tip.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.85))

## 先锋波数名称（主宰先锋/暗影先锋/风暴先锋）
func vanguard_wave_name() -> String:
	match dragon_minion_type:
		"storm": return "风暴先锋"
		"shadow": return "暗影先锋"
		_: return "主宰先锋"

## 该队伍剩余未出动的先锋波数（budget 按"路次"计，一波 = 3 路）
func vanguard_waves_left(team: int) -> int:
	if dominant_buff_team != team:
		return 0
	var left := dragon_minion_budget - dragon_count
	if left <= 0:
		return 0
	return int(ceil(float(left) / 3.0))

## 当前持有先锋资格的队伍（无则 -1）
func vanguard_owner() -> int:
	return dominant_buff_team
